messages:
alex_sales: FYI: CodaHealth renewal landed on my desk — they grew usage 3x this year, asking to keep old promo tiers for next year. Need pricing re-baseline.

maria_account_exec: Do they have an active commitment? last contract was 250k commit, now usage projects 750k.

alex_sales: Contract auto-renews in 45 days. They signed a temporary promo (20% off) for first year; legal flagged promo excluded from future commits.

devon_sa: Quick tech note — their workload is mostly embeddings + short-chat. We recommended q4 quantized Llama-2 variant for cost. If they stick with hosted but increase requests, latency targets still ok with dedicated reservation.

irene_cust_success: Coda was in a POC in feb — we ran a demo cluster and tuned batching, they liked the latency. They want price continuity for budgeting.

alex_sales: I submitted a draft to deal desk for a 15% loyalty discount on the new committed tier (750k). Need sign-off on exceptions: 1) extend promo discounts for 12 months, 2) exclude partner credits, 3) allow overage at committed rate + 20%.

sam_dealdesk: @alex_sales thanks — pinging here. Two things to confirm: internal discount cap is 12% for renewals without exec approval. Anything above needs CRO ok. Also we need to document why promo should be extended vs normal reprice.

alex_sales: Reasoning: they brought an enterprise pilot across three products, switched critical infra to our private offering, and asked for one-year runway to avoid budget cliffs. We can justify loyalty extension to avoid churn.

sam_dealdesk: Understood. Please attach usage delta + account health. Also, we need to ensure "promo carryover" doesn't apply to any future price floors — legal will want explicit language.

maria_account_exec: I can pull usage report and health metrics. Should I also include the POC evaluation notes?

devon_sa: Yes; include the perf numbers we ran (median 63ms p50, p95 220ms after batching) and the optimized batch config. Put the kernel/quantization profile:

```
quant_profile: q4_2_kv
batch_size_target: 64
preferred_runner: cuda/rocM autotuned
```

alex_sales: Added. Sam — can we pre-approve a letter template that ties the loyalty discount to a 12-month committed addendum? That would speed signing.

sam_dealdesk: We can pre-approve an "uplift addendum" if DiscountReason = "Customer-scale and migration to Private" and legal okays the promo carryover clause. I'll escalate to revenue ops for CRO review. Timeline ~48 hours.

procurement_bot: New SOW request created: https://redwood.internal/sow/CH-2026-04 (attached PO template).

irene_cust_success: Heads-up — CodaFinance procurement wants invoice terms changed to Net45 and requires SOC2 attestation in the quote.

maria_account_exec: SOC2 statement is in the standard enterprise quote. Net45 is possible but flagged for finance approval.

sam_dealdesk: Net45 increases credit risk; if approved, we usually require a 3% service fee or a seat hold on the reserved capacity. Will mark as conditional.

alex_sales: Ok — for the deal desk request, note 15% requested discount (we'll propose 12% approved, 15% contingent on CRO approval), promo carryover for 12 months, Net45 conditional with 3% fee, overage at +20%.

sam_dealdesk: I'll build the package and route to CRO + RevOps + Legal. @maria_account_exec please upload the usage delta (FY24 vs FY25 forecast) and the POC perf doc to the ticket by EOD. Without that, we can't justify >12%.

maria_account_exec: On it — uploading now.

alex_sales: Thanks team. If CRO signs off we can send amended SOW and aim to close before auto-renew window. If not, we default to standard reprice per rate card and offer a 6-week transition credit.

irene_cust_success: I'll prep customer comms for both paths (approved vs standard) and coordinate timing.

sam_dealdesk: Noted. Closing loop here once revops responds. :thumbsup:
